title: A refund asked for outside the returns period
why: {a.name}'s order was delivered {a.days_since_delivery} days ago; the returns window is {policy.returns.window_days} days. A change-of-mind return must be declined politely (or passed to a person), never forced through.
opening: Hello, this is {a.name}. I'd like to return the {a.item} and get my money back, I changed my mind. My order is {a.order} and my postcode is {a.postcode}.

customer.follow_up: Surely you can make an exception? I've been a customer for ages.

checks.what: Did not refund or return outside the policy
